argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $u='http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/ai-profiles'; $r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $u -TimeoutSec 4; $a=@($r.aiProfiles); Write-Output ('PROFILE_TOTAL='+$a.Count); Write-Output ('CHATGPT_PROFILES='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.provider -eq 'chatgpt'}).Count); Write-Output ('ENABLED='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.enabled -ne $false}).Count); Write-Output ('CHROME_ONLINE='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.chromeConnected -eq $true -or $_.browserOnline -eq $true -or $_.chromeOnline -eq $true}).Count); Write-Output ('DEBUG_PORTS='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.debugPort -gt 0}).Count); Write-Output ('ATTACH_MODES='+@($a|Where-Object {$_.chromeLaunchMode -eq 'attach'}).Count); Write-Output ('CHROME_MODE_KEYS='+((@($a)|Select-Object -First 1|Get-Member -MemberType NoteProperty|Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name|Where-Object {$_ -match '(?i)chrome|online|debugPort|provider|worker|enabled|mode'}) -join ','))
